# November Aircraft Registration

> November Aircraft Registration registers aircraft with the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for owners who are not US citizens. Based in Reno, Nevada. Run by William H. Gilliam, a US citizen who has done this work since the late 1980s.

Key facts:

- Service: FAA (N-number) aircraft registration for non-US citizens and foreign entities, worldwide.
- Structure: one US company per aircraft. The company is formed for that aircraft and holds nothing else. A US citizen holds the voting interest; the non-US owner holds the entire economic interest (use, benefit and cost).
- Not a pooled owner trust: no aircraft, money or records are shared with any other owner.
- Succession: each company's governing documents name a US-citizen successor to the voting interest.
- A US registration is not a tax plan, and the business does not give tax or legal advice.
- Contact: info@november-registration.com, phone or text +1 401 542 8641.
